Field Name
Description
UserId
This is the Falcon user name of the analyst manipulating the detect.
UserIp
This is the IP address or gateway from which this action was initiated.
OperationName
detection_update
ServiceName
detections
AuditKeyValues.Key &
AuditKeyValues.ValueString
AuditKeyValues.Key and AuditKeyValues.ValueString always come in pair (key/value). If the
AuditKeyValues.Key=detection_id, the ValueString is the Detect Id. If the AuditKeyValues.Key=new_state or
update_status, the ValueString is the new status for that Detect Id.
UTCTimestamp
Time when the operation took place in Unix epoch time.
